newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Czech Republic president Havel arrives in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Czech Republic president Havel arrives in Brazil.

text.p: Czech President Vaclav Havel arrived in Brazil on Sunday to start a week-long tour of Latin America's largest country, eyewitnesses said.

Havel, who was scheduled to visit an Indian reserve in the Amazon and a Brazilian city named after the Czech Republic town of Lidice that was destroyed by the Nazis in the Second World War, was to meet President Fernando Henrique Cardoso on Monday.
The Czech president's tour of Brazil, which was to be followed by visits to Chile, Argentina and Uruguay, was aimed at boosting trade ties, officials said.

But they added the personal similarities between the poet-president and Cardoso, a former leftwing sociologist who went into exile under Brazil's 1964-85 military governments, were likely to steal the show.
Several Czech businessmen accompanied Havel on his trip.
